sourceType: Official Government of Punjab tourism website
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source.
about: Former seat of the Jind princely state; also carries the heritage of Nabha, Patiala and Malerkotla states. Birthplace of Shaheed Udham Singh (Sunam). Malwa region.

places.name: Banasar Bagh & Deewan Khana Complex
places.facts: Summer seat of Jind State rulers; Marble Baradari (12-door pavilion) at its centre; Deewan Khana is Mughal-style, now a museum of Jind-era weapons, manuscripts, paintings.

places.name: Shahi Samadhan
places.facts: Royal cenotaph complex of Jind State rulers.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Nankiana Sahib
places.location: Village Mangwal, ~5km from Nabha Gate, Sangrur
places.facts: Visited by Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji, Guru Teg Bahadur Sahib Ji; Manji Sahib Patshahi marks where Guru Nanak delivered a sermon.

places.name: Kali Mata Temple
places.facts: Temple to Goddess Kali; large Navratri crowds.

places.name: Bir Aishwan Wildlife Sanctuary
places.facts: First protected area in Punjab, established 28 Feb 1952; 264.40 hectares; Nilgai, Jackal, Jungle Cat, Rhesus Macaque.

places.name: Ancestral House of Shaheed Udham Singh, Sunam
places.facts: Birthplace of Udham Singh, who assassinated Michael O'Dyer in 1940 for the Jallianwala Bagh massacre; hanged 31 July 1940. Annual Shaheedi Mela 31 July.

places.name: Gurdwara Gursagar Sahib, Mastuana Sahib
places.location: Mastuana Sahib, 6km west of Sangrur on Sangrur-Barnala Road
places.facts: Established by Sant Attar Singh (born village Cheema); Gur Sagar holy tank; degree college since 1920. Annual Jodh Mela 29-31 January.

places.name: Ancestral House of Akali Phoola Singh, Dehla Seehan
places.facts: Ancestral village of the celebrated Sikh military commander.

places.name: Quila Rahamtgarh, Malerkotla
places.facts: Fort in the historic Malerkotla princely territory.

places.name: Gurdwara Patshahi Chevin, Barnala
places.facts: Associated with Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji.

howToReach.note: West of Patiala, in the Malwa region.
